system.description: When you **_borrow some of the steading's assets for an expedition_** (like the horses or a plow), roll +Fortunes: **on a 10+**, go ahead, but bring it back safely; **on a 7-9**, you'll need to do some convincing; **on a 6-**, don't mark XP—you can take the asset with you if you want, but if you do, reduce Fortunes by 1.

success.value: Go ahead, but bring it back safely.

partial.value: You'll need to do some convincing.

failure.value: Don't mark XP. You can take the asset with you if you want, but if you do, reduce Fortunes by 1.
